 VINOD S. BHARDWAJ,
BHARDWAJ J. (Oral)

The instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioners in case bearing FIR No.04 dated 06.02.2025 registered under Sectionss 420, 120-B 120 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at Police Station City Ahmedgarh, District Malerkotla.
Malerkotl 2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner petitioners inter alia contends that pursuant to the order dated 24.12.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner petitioners have joined investigation and are no longer required for investigation of the case.
3. Learned counsel for the complainant opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

He, however, is not in a position to dispute that the allegations are primarily based upon documentary evidence and commercial transactions and that custodial interrogation oof the petitioners is not likely to lead to any fresh discovery of facts.
In the said circumstances, he contends that he may be permitted to raise all his pleas at 103-2 CRM-M-73485-2025 (O&M) an appropriate stage during the course of the trial and other proceedings.
He further seeks that the liberty of the complainant be protected.

sentences.text: 4. Learned State counsel on instructions, corroborates the said averment and submits that the custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not required for the purpose of investigation.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6.

Since the petitioners have joined the investigation and their custodial interrogation is not required, the present petition is allowed and the interim order dated 24.12.2025 is made absolute with liberty to the complainant as aforesaid.

7. However, if required, the petitioners shall continue to join investigation as and when required to do so and shall abide by the terms and conditions, as laid down under Section 482 (2) BNSS.
 (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ)
 07.03.2026 JUDGE  Sumit Gusain
